snippet.title: Announcement Trailer | Shrike
snippet.description:
Shrike is now on steam! Link Below
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842950/Shrike/

Building a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder about one birds migration north through hostile medieval bird kingdoms. Pickpocket rival flocks to build a deck. Steal abilities, stay hidden, survive. 

New trailer with updated art and gameplay!

#roguelike #gaming #steamgame #pixelart
